# Compress-It

> A web tool for reducing image file sizes and compressing videos in the browser.

## Main page

- [Compress-It](https://compress-it.raztom.com/): Compress JPG, PNG, GIF, and WebP images with quality, format, dimensions, or a target size. Video compression runs locally in the browser.

## Source and documentation

- [Source code](https://github.com/talktome8/compress-it): Project source and desktop application.
- [Desktop build guide](https://github.com/talktome8/compress-it/blob/main/DESKTOP_APP_GUIDE.md): Instructions for building the desktop version.
